name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza strikes 24 Nov; Riyadh tower hit 24 Nov
summary: Israeli strikes kill seven in Gaza on 24 Nov; a projectile hits a Riyadh tower 24 Nov amid Houthi attacks
state: Israeli strikes killed seven people in Gaza on 24 Nov, including Naeem Abu Nahal, head of Gaza's internal security service, Gaza's interior ministry said; Israel said it struck a senior Hamas member. Gaza's health ministry counts more than 1,650 Palestinians killed since the October 2025 truce (Euronews/AFP). A projectile hit a tower in Riyadh's financial district on 24 Nov, the second such strike in a week, amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia (Al Jazeera). Hostilities on the Gaza and Yemen–Saudi fronts, alongside the Gulf war, keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen or Saudi Arabia should follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against travel to several of these areas. Most of Gaza's 2.1 million people are displaced.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front hostilities (Israeli strikes in Gaza 24 Nov; strikes on Riyadh 19 and 24 Nov)
